IRAN IAN SOURCE SAYS NO FINAL AGREEMENT REACHED ON STRAIT "An agreement with Oman over the Strait of Hormuz has not been finalised," the senior Iran ian source told Reuters, adding that the talks were continuing on the details of an accord .
A spokesperson for Iran 's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said Iran and Oman had reached an agreement on their shares of the territory and revenues.
"The Strait of Hormuz belongs to Iran and the country of Oman ... We have been in negotiations with Oman for about a month, and we have reached results that are acceptable to both sides," Hossein Mohebbi said in comments published by Iran ian state media.
"In these negotiations, agreements have been reached regarding the share of each country in the waters of the Strait and the share of Iran and Oman in its revenues," he added.
It was not immediately clear at what stage of the negotiations the agreements had been reached. Iran had said earlier this month that a deal on the strait was close.
Following talks on Tuesday between Iran and Oman , Oman i Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi said he was "hopeful we will soon announce a temporary corridor for the Strait of Hormuz and practical arrangements to restore safe navigation".
US President Donald Trump has warned Oman against cooperating with Iran , telling Fox News on Aug 17: "If Oman gets in the way, we'll bomb the shit out of them."
The IRGC accused the United States of seeking to obstruct Iran 's negotiations with Oman and said this had caused an agreement to be delayed.
"If the United States stops obstructing and returns to the agreement, we can open the Strait of Hormuz within the framework of the agreement reached ... If the United States does not accept our conditions, the Strait of Hormuz will not be opened under any circumstances," Mohebbi said.

Related:

Iran and Oman discuss temporary Hormuz corridor as impasse with US drags on

Trump says Strait of Hormuz has been demined, warns Iran not to plant more

Iran vows to retaliate after US widens sanctions

ATTACKS ON SHIPPING Though active hostilities between the US and Iran have largely subsided in recent weeks, diplomatic efforts to reach a peace deal have stalled, and continuing attacks on ships mean passage through the Strait of Hormuz remains perilous.
Iran announced a blacklist on Sunday of 45 ships in an apparent effort to stop ship-to-ship transfers used by Gulf energy producers to evade the Iran ian blockade. Some companies plan to stop using vessels added to the blacklist, source s said.
In an effort to tighten pressure on Iran 's economy, the United States has threatened to punish countries that continue to do business with Iran , but said it would not impose penalties immediately.
The sanctions did not feature Chinese financial institutions suspected of facilitating oil exports from Iran that the US blockade has cut.
Iran denounced the US effort to isolate its economy as an act of "gross lawlessness", expressing confidence that many countries would not join the pressure campaign.
Oil prices fell for a third day, dropping more than 1.5 per cent, following signs of renewed efforts to seek a mediated end to the war that began on Feb 28 with US and Israeli strikes on Iran .

US REPORTEDLY NOT PLANNING NEW STRIKES FOR NOW Secretary of State Marco Rubio told allies that the US did not expect to launch new strikes against Iran for now, and would instead focus on other means of pressure, Axios reported on Tuesday.
US public approval of the war has fallen to its lowest level since the conflict's early days, and Trump's popularity is likewise at a record low ahead of congressional elections in November, accord ing to Reuters/Ipsos polling.
Thous and s of people have died in the conflict, most of them in Iran and Lebanon, while the US and Israel have degraded much of Iran 's conventional military capacity. The exact state of its nuclear program, which the US and Israel aim to dismantle, remains unknown.
Iran ian army spokesman Brigadier General Mohammad Akrami-Nia said new equipment had been delivered to combat units and fighting against two technologically advanced militaries had provided Iran 's forces with significant battlefield experience, accord ing to comments carried on Wednesday by Iran 's Mehr News.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: Most of U.S. aluminum comes from Canada. Industry says ‘good luck’ replacing it
items.author: Anam Khan
items.summary: The U.S. depends on Canada for 75 per cent of its imported primary aluminum, covering 60 per cent of its yearly usage, the association says. With 50 per cent tariffs in place, he says American ...
items.body: Canada’s aluminum industry is not worried about U.S. tariffs continuing into the new year. While Canadian domestic producers will absorb the loss of U.S. business and find other customers, the U.S. will find it nearly impossible to replace its cheapest supplier, says Jean Simard, president and chief executive officer at Aluminum Association of Canada. “We wish them good luck,” says Simard. The U.S. depends on Canada for 75 per cent of its imported primary aluminum, covering 60 per cent of its yearly usage, the association says. With 50 per cent tariffs in place, he says American industries, not Canadian smelters, will bear the brunt of the financial pain, as U.S. manufacturers face soaring production costs. “They’re pricing themselves out of export markets because, basically, they’re paying US$1500 to US$2,000 a tonne more for the metal than their competitors in Europe are paying for,” says Simard. Now that Canada has announced 50 per cent counter-tariffs on American goods to retaliate dollar for dollar, he doesn’t think the new tariffs on American aluminum will hurt Canada. “We’ve been there before,” says Simard. “The government has the means to be able to support any industry, any company that is bearing some of the impact of these tariffs on imports.” Canada will always have other markets The U.S. produces 675,000 tonnes of aluminum while it consumes four billion tonnes, he says. “They need the metal.” A U.S. Geological Survey report details the country’s shrinking metal-making infrastructure, showing that only two of the four remaining smelters are running at full capacity while the others are temporarily shut down. Even if proposed aluminum projects move ahead, by the end of the decade, he estimates domestic production would only be able to increase by one million tonnes, which is the expected increase in demand for that period of time. So while Canada’s aluminum has markets in the U.S. and Europe, it can arbitrage its way toward Europe and other markets, he says. “We will never be in dire need of finding markets. It’s the markets that are in dire need of finding metal,” says Simard. Aluminum production needs energy The U.S. simply does not have enough domestic production or available power to place the amount of Canadian aluminum its manufactures rely on, says Simard. “It’s all about energy,” he says. “They basically don’t really have the energy to back their destiny that they’ve set for themselves.” Canada says it produces about 3.3 million tonnes of aluminum and ships roughly 2.7 million tonnes to the U.S. Producing that amount of metal requires about 40 million megawatt-hours of energy, the equivalent of five Hoover Dams or the electricity consumption of 466 data centres, says Simard. Canada relies on abundant, clean hydroelectric energy to power its smelters. Nine out of 10 are in Quebec and use the massive river systems and provincial backed Hydro-Québec power contracts to secure low-cost renewable electricity. Creating jobs in the U.S. Simard says Canadian aluminum also creates jobs in the U.S. “For each job in Canada, we supply 13 jobs with metal in the U.S,” says Simard, while criticizing the country’s manufacturing sector. On the other hand, the U.S. Aluminum Association’s labour tracking shows that primary smelting employment has “declined significantly” over the last decade with heavy job losses from the dying raw-smelting plants. Meanwhile, Simard says Canadian aluminum producers have so far avoided the worst consequences of the trade fight. “We have not curtailed any capacity. We have not laid off anyone, and we don’t have any intention to do so,” said Simard. He says Canadian producers initially absorbed some losses when the U.S. tariff on aluminum rose to 50 per cent last year, but the market eventually adjusted and U.S. buyers began bearing the cost. He says a $7.5 billion package supports businesses and workers affected by the latest U.S. measures, targeting heavily impacted processing and transformation industries. “They’re priced out of the market with a 50 per cent tariff, and when they turn around to sell domestically, they’re stuck with competition coming from Asia, from China that undercuts the prices. So they need help.”

items.title: China Pushes Back as Taiwan Foreign Minister Heads to Pacific Islands Summit in Palau
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Taiwan Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung will attend events related to a major summit of leaders from Pacific island nations in Palau starting next week, his office said on Wednesday, though China said he had no right to take part. China’s test-firing in July of a …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
Taiwan Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung will attend events related to a major summit of leaders from Pacific island nations in Palau starting next week, his office said on Wednesday, though China said he had no right to take part.

China’s test-firing in July of a missile into the Pacific alarmed regional powers but failed to spur a unified response from Pacific Island governments, underscoring divisions over how to confront growing strategic competition in the region.

China, which views democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, has gradually whittled away the number of Pacific island countries with formal ties to Taipei, with only three remaining – Palau, Tuvalu and the Marshall Islands.

Taiwan’s foreign ministry said that Lin would leave for Palau on Thursday and be there for a week, taking part in side events to the summit, including a Pacific Islands Forum dialogue meeting hosted by the forum’s secretariat, and the Pacific Prosperity Exhibit.

Lin will also meet Taiwan’s Pacific diplomatic allies and “other friendly nations to exchange views on deepening the partnership between Taiwan and Pacific island nations, as well as jointly maintaining peace, stability and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific region,” the ministry said in a statement.

China says Taiwan is one of its provinces, not a country.

Beijing’s foreign ministry said Taipei had “no qualifications” to take part in the forum, which is being held from Sunday until September 4.

“The Taiwan authorities sending Lin Chia-lung and other Taiwan independence separatists scurrying about all over to curry favor is a futile attempt to grab attention,” it said in a statement sent to Reuters.

The forum’s Fiji-based secretariat did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the Chinese comments.

China has expanded its influence in the Pacific in recent years through infrastructure financing, diplomatic outreach and security cooperation, which has prompted concern among traditional partners including Australia, New Zealand and the United States.

（ブルームバーグ）： 26日の欧州債券市場は、米国債の動きに追随し下落した。米個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数が市場予想通り上昇したほか、原油が下げ幅を縮小したことが背景にある。

ドイツ10年債利回りは3ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇して3.23%となった。25日は1週間超ぶりの低水準を付けていた。

短期金融市場は欧州中央銀行（ECB）の利上げ観測を拡大し、年末までに42bp、来年9月までに60bpの利上げを織り込んだ。ECBのシュナーベル理事は26日、金利をさらに引き上げる必要があるとの見解を示した。

市場は、27日に公表される7月のECB政策委員会会合の議事要旨に注目している。

欧州株は、投資家がエヌビディアの決算発表を待つ中、ほぼ横ばいとなった。

ストックス欧州600指数は、ほぼ変わらずで取引を終了。銀行株や食品・飲料株が上昇したが、ヘルスケア株は下落した。

欧州株は先週の続落から持ち直し、ストックス欧州600指数は終値ベースの過去最高値まで1%未満の水準となっている。ただ、域内ではパフォーマンスにばらつきがあり、今年はイタリアとスペインが上昇を主導する一方、フランスとドイツは出遅れている。

（ブルームバーグ）： ロシアは和平合意に向けた協議が行き詰まったと判断し、ウクライナへの攻撃激化を準備している。ロシア大統領府に近い関係者3人が明らかにした。プーチン大統領が最終手段として、1945年の米国による日本への原爆投下以来使われていない核兵器を使用する可能性も指摘されている。

取り扱いに注意を要する問題だとして匿名を要請した関係者によると、現時点でロシアが検討しているのは、強力な従来型弾道ミサイルによる攻撃の激化で、キーウ中心部や他都市のインフラなどが標的になるという。

協議の枠組みは事実上全て崩壊し、双方の立場は振り出しに戻っていると、関係者は指摘。制裁による経済的圧力や、ロシアの石油精製施設や物流網に対するウクライナの攻撃を受けても、プーチン大統領が戦争を終結させることはないだろうと関係者は述べた。

関係者によると、北大西洋条約機構（NATO）加盟国がウクライナに兵器と情報を提供していることから、ウクライナの攻撃はNATOによる攻撃だとの受け止め方をロシアはますます強めている。現在の戦闘局面は、軍事的エスカレーションのピークではないと、関係者は語った。

プーチン氏は週末に国営テレビの記者に対し、ロシア経済への攻撃の影響について受け流した一方で、ウクライナは「パンドラの箱を開けた」と威嚇。「自国経済の最も痛い部分への予期しない結果を覚悟するがいい」と述べ、自身の意図を示唆した。

トランプ大統領の関心がイラン戦争に向く中で、ウクライナでの戦争終結を目指した米国の取り組みは事態を打開できず、交渉は停滞している。ロシアはまた、昨年8月にアラスカで行われたプーチン氏とトランプ氏の首脳会談で成立したと考えていた理解も、もはや当てにしていない。

両首脳の間で成立したとされる理解の実現には、戦争終結の合意の一環として米国がウクライナに東部ドネツク州を放棄するよう圧力をかけることが求められる。ウクライナが守っている残るドネツク州の各都市は要塞（ようさい）化され、ロシアが2014年から続く戦闘でも制圧できなかった地域だ。同地域を明け渡すよう求めるプーチン氏の要求を、ウクライナは一貫して拒んでいる。

Tim Curry, actor famed for Rocky Horror Picture Show, dead at 80

British actor Tim Curry's cause of death was not immediately disclosed.

Actor Tim Curry attends the 10th annual Costume Designers Guild Awards in Beverly Hills, California, on Feb 19, 2008. (Photo: Reuters/Phil McCarten)

FAST

Tim Curry , the baritone-voiced British actor who pranced to movie fame as a singing, lingerie-clad "sweet transvestite" in the 1975 cult classic The Rocky Horror Picture Show, has died at the age of 80, Variety and other outlets reported.
A cause of death was not immediately given, but Curry had been in ill health for some tim e.
Curry appeared in numerous movies, often as a hammy villain, was nominated three tim es for a Tony Award for Broadway roles, and performed voice work in many animated films and TV shows.
But his best-known role was Dr Frank N Furter, which came in his debut film, the outrageous, crowd-pleasing horror-comedy-musical The Rocky Horror Picture Show, co-starring Susan Sarandon and Barry Bostwick.
"I'm not much of a man by the light of day. But by night I'm one hell of a lover. I'm just a sweet transvestite from transsexual Transylvania," Curry sang in one scene as he strutted around with garish eye shadow and lipstick, in a skimpy black outfit complete with black stockings and garter belt.
In a 1975 television interview, Curry noted the risk of having his career defined by such an outlandish role – a prescient worry, as it turned out. "When I read it, I just thought it was very, very witty and funny," Curry said, although he confessed to some initial reluctance.
"I mean, I was hesitant in that, if it worked, it might be a difficult thing to shake off. But, really, I've always thought that it (a part) wasn't worth doing unless you took a risk," Curry said.
Among his other films were Charlie's Angels (2000), Muppet Treasure Island (1996), The Shadow (1994), The Three Musketeers (1993), Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992), Clue (1985), Legend (1985) and Annie (1982).

Tim Curry performs a number from the musical Spamalot during the Broadway premiere on Mar 17, 2005, in New York, (Photo: AP/Stuart Ramson)

OVER-THE-TOP VILLAINS Curry did much of his best work on stage. He was nominated for a Tony, Broadway's top honour, in 1981 for his role as Mozart in Amadeus, a tale of the great composer's interaction with jealous rival Salieri. Curry was also nominated for a Tony in 1993 for My Favorite Year and in 2005 for his role as King Arthur in the zany Monty Python's Spamalot.
Possessing a rich baritone voice, he was in demand as a voice actor for animated films and TV shows. He won a Day tim e Emmy Award in 1991 for his voice work on the animated Peter Pan & The Pirates.
With his sinister grin and menacing laugh, Curry was frequently cast in Hollywood films as a villain – some tim es with comic overtones, which let him deliver the type of over-the-top performances for which he was famed.
"I do love those roles – they're always the best written," Curry told interviewer Andrew Kay in 2011.
He conceded that some of his movies were mediocre, singling out 1995's Congo, a tale of diamond mines and killer gorillas.
"I was really very bad in it," Curry said. "I won a Razzy award for one of the worst performances of the year – and I richly deserved it, too."

A CULT FOLLOWING Curry was born in the English village of Grappenhall, Cheshire, on Apr 19, 1946. His father, a Royal Navy chaplain, died when he was 12. His mother was a school secretary.
Curry studied drama at Birmingham University.
In 1973, he landed the part of Dr Frank N Furter in the original London stage version of The Rocky Horror Show. He performed the play in New York and Los Angeles before it was made into a film, renamed as The Rocky Horror Picture Show.
The movie was not an instant hit but won a cult following in midnight screenings in New York City and elsewhere, with audience members often dressing up as Rocky Horror characters.
Curry withdrew from a British stage production in 2011 due to ill health. In 2013, his agent said that he had suffered a stroke but was recovering "in great humour". From then on, he used a wheelchair and reduced his workload. In 2024, he did, however, return to the big screen, appearing in the horror film Stream.
Curry , who lived in Los Angeles, never married and had no children. A composer and a singer, Curry also performed with his own rock band and released a handful of albums.

Source: Reuters/fs

Kremlin says US spy chief met with Russian counterparts during Moscow visit

US President Donald Trump did not make it clear what the officials were there to discuss, but said the visit could be useful, adding, “something may come out of it” as efforts to end the Ukraine war continue.

MOSCOW: US CIA Director John Ratcliffe spoke with R us sian intelligence officials during a visit to Moscow but did not meet Russian President Vladimir Putin, the Kremlin said on Wednesday (Aug 26) of a trip that US President Donald Trump described as "semi-routine."
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters Putin had been briefed on the outcome of Tuesday's visit , which came as the war in Ukraine drags on and as efforts to reach a lasting peace between the United States and Iran have stalled.
Peskov declined to say what had been disc us sed or to provide any further details.
"All I can tell you is that there have been contacts via the security services. I can tell you that there have been no meetings with the R us sian president. Naturally, President Putin is kept informed of everything without delay," said Peskov.

Trump, in a radio interview on Wednesday, did not say specifically why Ratcliffe had travelled to Moscow but said it could prove us eful.
"Now so met hing may come ... out of it. We're working very hard to get that war ended," Trump told the Glenn Beck Program, referring to the war in Ukraine.

Related:

Asked whether the CIA chief went to Moscow to disc us s potential R us sian action to test the NATO military alliance or to disc us s Iran sanctions, Trump added: "None of the above. He's there, you know, very sort of semi-routine."
The last known visit by a US CIA director to the R us sian capital took place when Ratcliffe's predecessor William Burns held talks with Putin in November 2021, three months the war in Ukraine began.
Asked if visit s by such senior US officials could help improve the dire state of US-R us sia relations, Peskov said that contacts between the two countries' intelligence agencies were a positive thing.
"These contacts often continue even during the most difficult periods in bilateral relations. Our president, incidentally, has spoken about this. However, it is still too early to say to what extent this will, overall, help to steer our bilateral relations out of the profound crisis in which they currently find themselves," he said.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: CIA長官のモスクワ訪問、「緊張緩和が目的」－リトアニア大統領
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米中央情報局（CIA）のラトクリフ長官による異例のロシア訪問について、リトアニアのナウセーダ大統領は26日、地政学的緊張の緩和を目的とした可能性が高いとの見方を示した。

ナウセーダ氏は記者会見で、会談の内容について「おそらく来週」にパートナー国から説明を受ける見通しだとして、協議の目的については具体的な言及を避けた。同氏は「会談は、われわれの地域の地政学的緊張を緩和することを真の目的としていたと考えている。それは前向きなことだ」と語った。

欧州全域で最近、ロシアによる破壊工作の動きが活発化している。ラトクリフ氏のモスクワ訪問に先立ち、米情報当局者は、ロシアの情報・治安機関がバルト3国やポーランドを対象に、インフラへの破壊工作や偽旗攻撃などを含む可能性のあるハイブリッド戦を検討していると警告していた。

欧州では、武装ドローンによる領空侵犯や暗殺未遂、原因不明の放火などが相次いでいる。こうした行為は、ウクライナに武器や資金を提供する主要国への威嚇が狙いとみられる。

事情に詳しい関係者によると、ラトクリフ氏は25日、会談のためロシアを訪れた。協議の内容は明らかになっていない。CIAはコメントを控えた。

原題：Moscow Visit by CIA Chief Aimed to Ease Tensions, Lithuania Says（抜粋）

items.title: ネパールの洪水で少なくとも157人死亡、日本人含む数百人行方不明
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ネパールと中国の国境で26日、激しい土石流と洪水が発生し、検問所や周辺の村々をのみ込んだ。ネパール警察は27日、少なくとも157人の死亡を確認した。近隣のインド各地域でも避難の動きや警報の発令が広がっている。

インドやマレーシア、英国、米国、オーストラリアなどからの外国人約300人が行方不明となっていることも確認された。

木原稔官房長官は27日午前の記者会見で、ネパール側でツアーに参加していたとみられる日本人5名と連絡が取れていないことを明らかにした。中国側では邦人被害は確認されていないという。日本政府はネパール当局に対して捜索救助を依頼したほか、関係当局などから情報収集を行っている。

高市早苗首相は、日本人5人が行方不明と報じられたので「心配しています」とXに投稿。5人に現地日本大使館が連絡を取っても応答がなく、捜索依頼したと説明した。

オーストラリアのアルバニージー首相によると、オーストラリア人34人が行方不明だという。

オンラインに投稿された動画には、ネパール北部ラスワ郡の山岳地帯で、現地時間26日午前8時30分ごろに突然発生した洪水によって道路や橋が流される様子が映っている。

ネパール国家災害リスク軽減管理庁はXへの投稿で、衛星画像の初期分析によると、ネパール・中国国境で発生した地滑りによりレンデ川が洪水が発生した可能性があると説明した。

国際総合山岳開発センターとネパール、中国の提携機関の科学者は、高地で発生した氷と岩石の崩落が洪水の引き金となった可能性について調べている。

ネパールの首都カトマンズに拠点を置く同センターは発表資料で、映像や被災地からの情報に基づく初期評価では、大量の氷や岩石が川に流れ込んだ可能性があると説明した。それによって急激な増水が生じ、水や土砂、大きな岩石が下流へ一気に押し流された可能性がある。

中国ではチベット自治区の吉隆県が被災した。オンラインで拡散している動画には、大量の泥水が一帯を押し流す様子が映っている。習近平・中国国家主席はチベット自治区で全力を挙げて救助活動に当たるよう指示した。今年、中国で最も多くの死者を出した自然災害の一つとなる可能性がある。

items.title: States, voting rights groups renew challenges to Trump plans to restrict mail-in voting
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: Democratic-led states and voting rights groups renewed their efforts to block the U.S. Postal Service from imposing new requirements on mail-in voting before ballots go out for the November congressional elections.
items.body:
Democratic-led states and voting rights groups on Wednesday renewed their efforts to block the U.S. Postal Service from imposing new requirements on mail-in voting before ballots go out for the November congressional elections, as ordered by President Donald Trump.
Democratic attorneys general from 23 states and the District of Columbia, along with Pennsylvania's governor, filed a new lawsuit in Boston federal court two days after the U.S. Supreme Court [USN:nL1N44L0WS TEXT:"lifted an earlier injunction"] they had won blocking Trump's order on the grounds that they sued too soon.
They had filed that earlier case before USPS had finalized the rule that would implement the order the Republican president signed in March targeting mail-in ballots. USPS released a final rule on Friday, despite a court order that had still been in place designed to stop its efforts from fulfilling Trump's plan.
Until Wednesday, USPS had been blocked from implementing that new rule as a result of [USN:L1N44M0UE TEXT:"another injunction"] U.S. District Judge Indira Talwani in Boston issued in a related case brought by voting rights groups.
But at the Trump administration's request, Talwani vacated her order shortly after the states sued. The judge said it cannot stand following the Supreme Court's ruling given that they initially sued before USPS finalized its rule, despite "what chaos may be unleashed as litigation is pending."
Those voting rights groups quickly filed a revised complaint after she ruled, and along with the states asked Talwani, an appointee of Democratic President Barack Obama, to quickly issue a restraining order that would re-block implementation of USPS' new rule.
"Rather than serving voters, this rule threatens access to the ballot and treats voters as collateral damage," Sophia Lin Lakin, a lawyer for the voting rights groups at the American Civil Liberties Union, said in a statement.
Talwani ordered the Trump administration to respond to the restraining order requests by mid-Thursday, and she scheduled a September 3 hearing to consider whether to issue a preliminary injunction that would indefinitely halt the rule.
Under the rule, states must supply USPS with lists of mail ballot recipients, and all outbound and return ballot envelopes must bear unique barcodes. USPS under the rule may refuse to deliver ballots that do not comply with the new standards or are associated with voters who do not appear on the lists.
The Democratic-led states say the new requirements, if put into force, could significantly burden them in the weeks running up to the election, forcing them to buy new envelopes and equipment, establish new systems and train staff.
"This new policy will just create confusion, unnecessary costs, and unacceptable risks for voters going into Election Day, and my office is going to court to stop it," New York Attorney General Letitia James said in a statement.
She and other state attorneys general argue USPS has no authority to establish federal eligibility requirements to vote by mail and that its rule ran afoul of federal laws protecting voters' rights and states' authority under the U.S. Constitution to administer elections.
The states, which also include California and Massachusetts, argue the rule risks disenfranchising voters. During the 2024 election, USPS processed nearly 100 million ballots. About 30% of voters nationwide cast ballots by mail, the states say.
USPS did not respond to requests for comment.
Arms of the Democratic Party in filings on Tuesday in a separate case in Washington, D.C., similarly moved to block USPS' rule, which they say is now ripe for adjudication.

items.title: 【米国市況】債券安、PCE統計後も年内利上げ観測変わらず－株横ばい
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 26日の米株式市場ではS&P500種株価指数がほぼ変わらず。エヌビディアの決算発表を前に積極的な売買が手控えられ、方向感に乏しい展開となった。米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が年内に利上げを実施するとの観測から国債利回りは上昇した。

エヌビディアは決算発表を控え、株価が1.6%下落。S&P500種はもみ合う場面が目立った。国債市場では短期債の下げが相対的にきつかった。米経済が引き続き堅調であることを示す統計を受け、短期金融市場は12月までのFRB利上げを完全に織り込んだ。

7月の米個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数はコアが前年同月比で3.3%上昇と、予想通りになったものの、なおFRBの目標を大きく上回っている。原油相場は荒い値動き。ロシアがウクライナでの戦争を激化させる動きに出ているとのブルームバーグの報道を受け、急伸する場面もあった。

モルガン・スタンレー・ウェルス・マネジメントのエレン・ゼントナー氏によると、利上げ観測を強める材料への警戒感が根強いなか、最新の経済指標は必ずしも市場が望んでいた内容ではなかった。

4－6月期（第2四半期）の米実質国内総生産（GDP）改定値は前期比年率1.5%増と、速報値から変わらずで、市場予想に一致した。ただ、内訳では個人消費と設備投資が速報値より強かった。

今回のデータだけで9月の米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）会合を巡る情勢を変えるには至らなかったが、今後の指標も同じ方向を示せば、政策当局者は様子見姿勢の修正を迫られる可能性があると、ゼントナー氏は指摘した。

eToro（イートロ）のブレット・ケンウェル氏は「課題はますます明確になっている。インフレ率は依然として高過ぎる。ウォーシュFRB議長が28日のジャクソンホールでの講演で、インフレ率を長期目標に戻す道筋を示すかどうかに注目が集まっている」と述べた。

LPLファイナンシャルのジェフ・ローチ氏によると、転換点が近づいている可能性はあるものの、所得の伸びがインフレ率を上回る状況が続いており、消費者には追い風となっている。

items.title: 米国債下落、コアPCE価格発表後も利上げ観測変わらず－株もみ合い
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 26日午前の米株式相場は方向感に乏しい展開。最新の米経済指標を受けても米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が年内に利上げを実施するとの観測に変化はなく、国債売りが優勢になっている。

7月の米個人消費支出（PCE）は実質ベースで前月比横ばいとなり、注目度の高いPCE価格指数はコアが予想通りとなった。4－6月期（第2四半期）の米実質国内総生産（GDP）改定値は前期比年率1.5%増と、速報値から変わらずで、市場予想に一致した。

短期金融市場は12月までの利上げを完全に織り込んでいる。国債市場では相対的に短期債の下げがきつい。

S&P500種株価指数はもみ合い。市場はエヌビディアの決算発表待ちとなっている。

イランとオマーンがホルムズ海峡の再開に向けて協議する中、原油は下落した。

外国為替市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇。円は対ドルで下げに転じ、1ドル＝159円台前半で推移している。

items.title: ウォルター氏のTWG、「不正一切ない」－ドジャースは売却予定なし
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米大リーグ（MLB）のドジャース筆頭オーナー、マーク・ウォルター氏の事業帝国の中核をなす持ち株会社TWGグローバルは、米検察当局による同社への捜査が続く中、自社に対する「多方面からの攻撃」だとして反論した。

TWGは26日の発表文で、米司法省と米証券取引委員会（SEC）による捜査・調査に対応し、問題の解決に向けて両当局と協力していると説明した。焦点の一つとなっている保険事業についても、規制当局の懸念解消に向けた計画を提出したという。

同社は「これまでの報道にもかかわらず、不正は一切なかった」と主張。「被害者はいない。誰も被害を受けておらず、被害を受けたと主張する人もいない」と述べた。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースはこれまでに、米規制当局と米検察当局がウォルター氏の広範な投資帝国について、傘下の保険会社2社やグッゲンハイム・パートナーズで金融上の不正がなかったか調査・捜査していると報じている。

こうした問題への対応を迫られる一方、TWGはさまざまな取引を進めようとしている。ウォルター氏は今月、NBAのロサンゼルス・レイカーズをプロスポーツ史上最高額の125億ドルでジョシュ・クシュナー氏とボブ・アイガー氏に売却することで合意した。

TWGは、保険事業の資金を調達するために「スポーツ資産を『安値』で売却しようとしているわけではない」と説明。例えばレイカーズの売却価格は、ウォルター氏が1年足らず前に取得した際の価格を25%上回ったとしている。

ドジャースについては売却する予定はなく、「売却手続きも開始していない」とした。

そのうえで「TWGとウォルター氏、そのパートナーが保有するスポーツ資産には、買収希望者や共同投資家から継続的に関心が寄せられている。責任あるオーナー、投資家として、真剣な提案があれば全て検討している」と述べた。

原題：Walter’s TWG Hits Back at Fraud Claims, Says It Has No Victims（抜粋）

items.title: メタ、最大2.8兆円支払いで米各州と大型和解－若者のSNS依存訴訟
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： フェイスブックとインスタグラムを10代の若者が依存するよう意図的に設計したとして、米29州でメタ・プラットフォームズが訴えられた大型訴訟で、メタは和解費用として、最大180億ドル（約2兆8700億円）を支払うことに合意した。フェイスブックやインスタグラムなどの運営方法についても大幅な変更を迫られる。

26日に提出された裁判資料によると、メタのプラットフォームに新たな安全対策を導入することが義務付けられる。若者が画面をスクロールして利用できる時間を制限するほか、保護者の同意なしに一部の安全設定を解除できないようにすることなどが含まれる。

今回の合意には、複数の訴訟で争われているさまざまな請求を解決するための支払いが含まれる。中でも焦点となったのが、カリフォルニア州オークランドで進んでいた裁判だ。複数の州は、若年層が繰り返し利用するよう促す仕組みをメタがフェイスブックとインスタグラムに意図的に組み込んだと主張していた。

裁判資料によると、メタはこの訴訟の解決に最大167億ドルを支払うことで合意した。これに加え、他のプライバシー関連の請求を解決するために4億5900万ドル、訴訟費用として7500万ドルを支払う。また別途、テキサス州に最大10億ドルを支払うことで合意したとメタは明らかにした。

支払いの一部は、他のSNS企業が同様のプラットフォーム変更を導入し、それぞれ支払いを行うことが条件となっている。

ゴンザレスロジャース米連邦地裁判事は26日、裁判をいったん中断した後、和解を承認した。これに先立ち提出された合意概要では、メタは自社に対する主張を否定し、今回の合意は責任を認めるものではないとした。

カリフォルニア州オークランドの連邦裁判所で行われている審理は2週目に入っており、メタに極めて大きなリスクとなっていた。29州の司法長官らは、各州の住民を代表して巨額の金銭的制裁を求めるとともに、メタにプラットフォームの運営方法の変更を義務付けるよう求めていた。

items.title: メタ、最大167億ドルで米国の各州と和解－若者のSNS依存巡る訴訟
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： フェイスブックとインスタグラムを10代の若者が依存するよう意図的に設計したとして、米29州でメタ・プラットフォームズが訴えられた大型訴訟で、メタは和解費用として、最大167億ドル（約2兆6600億円）を支払うことに合意した。26日に提出された裁判書類で分かった。

合意では、メタに対し、フェイスブックやインスタグラムなどのプラットフォームに新たな安全対策を導入するよう義務付けている。若者が画面をスクロールして利用できる時間を制限するほか、保護者の同意なしに一部の安全設定を解除できないようにすることなどが含まれる。合意には裁判官の承認が必要となる。

各州は、州の消費者保護法と連邦プライバシー法への違反があったと主張していたが、メタは提出書類で、この申し立てを否定した。提出書類は「本合意は和解のみを目的として締結されるもので、メタが責任、不正行為、または地方、州、連邦、国際法への違反を認めるものではない」としている。

カリフォルニア州オークランドの連邦裁判所で行われている審理は2週目に入っており、メタに極めて大きなリスクとなっていた。29州の司法長官らは、各州の住民を代表して巨額の金銭的制裁を求めるとともに、メタにプラットフォームの運営方法の変更を義務づけるよう求めていた。

メタ株は、26日のニューヨーク市場で一時1.4%安となった。取引開始直後には一時4.1%高だった。

和解案には、合意内容が順守されているかを監督する独立監査人の選任も盛り込まれている。監査人は独自に改善策を勧告し、調査結果を各州に報告できる。アプリ上の若年利用者をより正確に特定できるよう、メタに年齢確認機能の強化も義務付けた。10代の利用者については、投稿の「いいね」の数を閲覧する機能や、美容フィルターなどへのアクセスも制限される。

カリフォルニア州のロブ・ボンタ司法長官は「メタは、同社のプラットフォームがもたらす危害のリスクを減らすため、大規模な改革を行うことに合意した。数カ月以内に実施する」との声明を発表した。

items.title: Landmark Bolivia same-sex marriage could pave way for more couples, activists say
items.author: Sergio Limachi, Andrea Rodriguez
items.creator: Sergio Limachi, Andrea Rodriguez
items.summary: The marriage of a same-sex couple in Bolivia this month could prompt other couples to seek the same recognition, activists say, potentially opening a new chapter in a years-long push for LGBT rights in the socially conservative Andean nation.
items.body:
The marriage of a same-sex couple in Bolivia this month could prompt other couples to seek the same recognition, activists say, potentially opening a new chapter in a years-long push for LGBT rights in the socially conservative Andean nation.
Fabiana Justiniano and Scarlett Rocha applied to marry in October 2022. After nearly four years of legal proceedings and two constitutional appeals, they won a ruling in March 2026 clearing the way for their wedding — Bolivia's first legally recognized same-sex marriage.
"We had many doubts, a lot of uncertainty ... because the process was so long and during the process there were so many barriers, so many limitations, even on the day of the wedding," Rocha said.
For Justiniano, the union brought a different kind of relief. "For me, marriage means peace," she said, recalling their first night home as a married couple, when she realized everything they had built now belonged "only and exclusively to us."
Nonetheless, the Bolivian court's ruling applies only to their specific case. Same-sex marriage is not yet available nationwide through Bolivia's administrative rules, and future access will hinge on further Constitutional Court rulings.
Mateo Rodrigo, a lawyer with Equal Bolivia who represented the couple, said the ruling has already triggered interest from others.
"Since Fabiana and Scarlett's wedding we have already received quite a few requests, around five to 10 couples have approached us," he said, though many remain hesitant given the nearly four-year fight the couple endured.
Same-sex civil unions similarly moved into legal territory after a landmark case in 2020, when David Aruquipa and Guido Montaño won a two-year legal battle.
It took until 2023 for further court rulings to make the registration of same-sex civil unions broadly available.
Since then, Bolivia has recognized 148 same sex-civil unions, said Paola Tapia, who oversees the vulnerable populations unit at Bolivia's Ombudsman's Office. She added that unions still carry fewer practical protections than marriage.
"With marriage, we're opening many more doors. With civil unions, we opened a few," said Montaño. "The situation now is much better for people who can choose between marriage and a civil union."
Cuba in 2022 became the [USN:L1N30X2L6 TEXT:"latest country"] in Latin America to legalize gay marriage and adoption, but little has changed in the region since.
Same-sex marriage remains illegal or unrecognized across much of Central America, Paraguay, Peru, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname and parts of the Caribbean.

items.title: 世界の中銀当局者、ジャクソンホールでインフレのリスク強調へ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ワイオミング州で27－29日、ジャクソンホール会合（カンザスシティー連銀主催の年次シンポジウム）が開催される。各国の中央銀行当局者は、世界経済が新たな脅威に直面する中、世界的にインフレへの認識が見直され、借り入れコストが上昇する可能性を強調するとみられる。

昨年のジャクソンホール会合では、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のパウエル議長（当時）が利下げへの道筋をつける一方、欧州の当局者は追加緩和を議論していた。今年、政策当局者から発せられるメッセージは、大きく異なるものになりそうだ。

イラン戦争やAI投資ブーム、異常気象による物価上昇圧力に直面し、一部の中央銀行はすでに利上げに踏み切っており、他の中銀も続くと予想されている。市場と同様、中央銀行当局者も、ウォーシュFRB議長の発言に注目しているが、ウォーシュ氏はこれまで、物価上昇への対応について明確な姿勢を示すことを避けてきた。

投資家の間では、最近の物価上昇圧力が、政府の債務水準上昇と重なる場合の影響への警戒が強まっている。長期債利回りは数十年ぶりの高水準に達し、米財務省は長期国債を買い戻す計画を打ち出すという市場介入に踏み切った。

ドイツのシン・アイス・マクロエコノミクスのチーフエコノミスト、スピロス・アンドレオプロス氏は「世界の中央銀行当局者は慎重な判断に傾き、インフレをあえて取りたくないリスクとして扱う可能性が高い。次の供給ショックがいつ起きるかは誰にも分からない」と語った。

2022年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻後に起きたエネルギー価格の急騰は、ホルムズ海峡の情勢を注視する当局者の脳裏に、なお強く残っている。価格上昇を当初過小評価した当時の経験から、多くの当局者は現在、供給途絶のリスクにより敏感になっている。

欧州中央銀行（ECB）は6月に0.25ポイントの利上げを実施し、9月にも再び同幅の利上げに踏み切るとの見方が広がっている。ジャクソンホール会合には、ECBからシュナーベル理事らが参加する。オーストラリア、ノルウェー、インドネシアの中央銀行も今年、利上げした。

items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ワイオミング州で27－29日、ジャクソンホール会合（カンザスシティー連銀主催の年次シンポジウム）が開催される。各国の中央銀行当局者は、世界経済が新たな脅威に直面する中、世界的にインフレへの認識が見直され、借り入れコストが上昇する可能性を強調するとみられる。

昨年のジャクソンホール会合では、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のパウエル議長（当時）が利下げへの道筋をつける一方、欧州の当局者は追加緩和を議論していた。今年、政策当局者から発せられるメッセージは、大きく異なるものになりそうだ。

イラン戦争やAI投資ブーム、異常気象による物価上昇圧力に直面し、一部の中央銀行はすでに利上げに踏み切っており、他の中銀も続くと予想されている。市場と同様、中央銀行当局者も、ウォーシュFRB議長の発言に注目しているが、ウォーシュ氏はこれまで、物価上昇への対応について明確な姿勢を示すことを避けてきた。

投資家の間では、最近の物価上昇圧力が、政府の債務水準上昇と重なる場合の影響への警戒が強まっている。長期債利回りは数十年ぶりの高水準に達し、米財務省は長期国債を買い戻す計画を打ち出すという市場介入に踏み切った。

ドイツのシン・アイス・マクロエコノミクスのチーフエコノミスト、スピロス・アンドレオプロス氏は「世界の中央銀行当局者は慎重な判断に傾き、インフレをあえて取りたくないリスクとして扱う可能性が高い。次の供給ショックがいつ起きるかは誰にも分からない」と語った。

2022年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻後に起きたエネルギー価格の急騰は、ホルムズ海峡の情勢を注視する当局者の脳裏に、なお強く残っている。価格上昇を当初過小評価した当時の経験から、多くの当局者は現在、供給途絶のリスクにより敏感になっている。

欧州中央銀行（ECB）は6月に0.25ポイントの利上げを実施し、9月にも再び同幅の利上げに踏み切るとの見方が広がっている。ジャクソンホール会合には、ECBからシュナーベル理事らが参加する。オーストラリア、ノルウェー、インドネシアの中央銀行も今年、利上げした。

items.title: 米GDP、4－6月は年率1.5%増で予想と一致－消費と投資は上方修正
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 4－6月期（第2四半期）の米実質国内総生産（GDP）改定値は前期比年率1.5%増と、速報値から変わらずで、市場予想に一致した。ただ、内訳では個人消費と設備投資が当初発表より強かった。

経済活動の3分の2超を占める個人消費は年率3.4%増と、速報値の3.2%増から上方修正された。非住宅固定投資は8.5%増加した。

基調的な需要をより狭く捉える民間国内最終需要は4.2%増加。速報値の3.9%増から上方修正され、約3年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。同指標は純輸出、在庫、政府支出を除く。

政府支出は4－6月に1%減少した。国防以外の支出が大幅に落ち込んだことを反映した。

一方、食品とエネルギーを除く個人消費支出（PCE）価格コア指数は、上昇率が3.4%から3.6%に上方修正された。

26日に発表された別の統計では、7月のコアPCE価格指数が前月比0.2%上昇した。また、実質個人消費が7月に前月比横ばいとなったことも示された。過去2カ月はより力強い伸びだった。

原題：US Economy Expands 1.5% With Spending, Investment Revised Up (1)（抜粋）

items.title: 米PCEコア価格指数、小幅な伸び－個人消費支出は実質ベースで停滞
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 市場が注目する米個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数は7月、コアの伸びが市場予想通りとなり、実質PCEは横ばいにとどまった。米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が当面、政策金利を据え置く余地が広がった。

今回の統計は、初夏の時期に堅調だった個人消費が一服し、7月に米経済が減速したことを示唆する他の一連の指標と整合的な内容となった。

多くのFRB当局者はイラン戦争に伴うインフレ圧力が後退している兆候を見極めようとしており、次回9月の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）で政策金利を据え置くための論拠は今回のPCEで高まる可能性がある。

ただ、PCE総合価格指数の前年同月比3.7%上昇は、FRBのインフレ目標である2%を依然として大きく上回っている。

リージョンズ・ファイナンシャルのチーフエコノミスト、リチャード・ムーディー氏は「7月の数字は抑制されたものだったが、FRBにとって唯一の問題はインフレ率が目標を上回っていることだ」と指摘。「インフレは一段と加速していくようにはみえないが、目標に向かって低下していくようにもみえない」と述べた。

PCE統計の発表後、米国債利回りとドルは上げ幅を拡大した。S&P500種株価指数は下落で始まった。米金利先物市場が見込む9月のFOMC会合での利上げ確率は40%近くで、これは発表前とほぼ変わらず。ただ、市場は年内の利上げを引き続き織り込んでいる。

市場が注目するエネルギーと住宅を除くサービスインフレの指標は前月比0.3%上昇。ポートフォリオ運用と投資助言サービスの手数料が5.6%上昇し、1年ぶりの高い伸びとなったことが影響した。

発表元の米経済分析局（BEA）は来月から、法務サービスやコンピューターソフトウエア、投資助言など一部分野で価格の算出方法を変更する予定で、エコノミストの多くは、これがPCE価格指数の引き下げにつながるとみている。

items.title: US-Canada Tariffs Are a Sideshow to the Real Trade Risks
items.author: Scott Lincicome
items.creator: Scott Lincicome
items.summary: After US-Canada trade talks collapsed Friday, the United States imposed a 50% tariff on a long list of Canadian goods via the never-used Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930. US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer went on TV first thing Monday in an attempt to calm financial markets with some basic tariff math. He said the new action hits a small percentage of Canadian imports into the US and an even smaller share of consumption, so there’s “no possible way it can really affect US well-being.”

items.title: ホルムズ収益分配でオマーンと合意､イラン報道－米大統領 ｢機雷ない｣
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： イランは26日、ホルムズ海峡を巡りオマーンと収益分配で合意したと明らかにした。一方、トランプ米大統領は海峡の機雷を除去したと改めて主張。ただ、同盟国は懐疑的な見方を示している。

「イランとオマーンは、海峡の水域に関するそれぞれの割り当て分、および収益配分について合意に達した」とする革命防衛隊（IRGC）報道官の発言をセパ通信が報じた。

報道官はその上で、「米国がこのプロセスを妨害しており、進展の遅れを招いている」と述べたが、詳細には触れなかった。

今回の革命防衛隊の発表は、両国外務省が25日に発表した共同声明より踏み込んだ内容だ。共同声明では、同海峡での船舶通航再開を目指す「暫定的な枠組み」について協議したと明らかにしていたが、最終合意には至っておらず、通航料についても言及しなかった。

イラン当局者は、ホルムズ海峡を巡ってオマーンと合意しても、直ちに航行が再開されることを意味するわけではないと繰り返し警告している。

トランプ米大統領はこの日、「機雷はなくなった」との主張を改めて繰り返した。ラジオ番組のインタビューで「ホルムズ海峡は開いている。今では多くの船舶を海峡に通している」と述べ、前日には約1000万バレルが同海峡を通過したと付け加えた。

イランはトランプ氏の主張を否定し、爆発物の位置を把握しているのはイラン当局者だけだとしている。国際海事機関（IMO）のトップも先週、同海峡は開かれておらず、機雷が除去されたとの確認も取れていないと述べた。

米国の同盟国も、ホルムズ海峡には依然として機雷が残っている可能性が高いと非公式に警告している。

匿名を条件に話した関係者によると、米国は公海上の機雷除去で一定の進展を遂げた可能性が高いが、イランが敷設したとみられる80－150個の機雷全てを除去できたわけではないと、同盟国側はみている。

items.title: イラン、ホルムズ海峡の収益分配でオマーンと合意－革命防衛隊
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： イランは26日、ホルムズ海峡を巡りオマーンと収益分配で合意したと明らかにした。両国は、エネルギー海上輸送の要衝である同海峡の管理を巡って、より広範な合意を目指している。

「イランとオマーンは、海峡の水域に関するそれぞれの割り当て分、および収益配分について合意に達した」とする革命防衛隊（IRGC）報道官の発言をセパ通信が報じた。

報道官はその上で、「米国がこのプロセスを妨害しており、進展の遅れを招いている」と述べたが、詳細には触れなかった。

今回の革命防衛隊の発表は、両国外務省が25日に発表した共同声明より踏み込んだ内容だ。共同声明では、同海峡での船舶通航再開を目指す「暫定的な枠組み」について協議したと明らかにしていたが、最終合意には至っておらず、通航料についても言及しなかった。

イラン当局者は、ホルムズ海峡を巡ってオマーンと合意しても、直ちに航行が再開されることを意味するわけではないと繰り返し警告している。

イランは、船舶通航の正常化には、米国が6月に署名した覚書の条件を履行することが必要だと主張している。条件には、対イラン制裁や同国港湾への海上封鎖、およびイラン凍結資産の解除などが含まれるが、米国はいずれについても応じる用意があるとの姿勢を示していない。

今月初めに失効した60日間の暫定合意は、ホルムズ海峡の管理を巡って米国とイランが対立する中、早い段階からたびたび破られていた。ホルムズ海峡の通航正常化を促す合意が成立すれば、恒久的な和平合意に向けた協議再開に道を開く可能性がある。

関係者によると、イランは戦争開始当初、一部船舶から通航料を徴収し始めたが、その後は料金をサービス料と位置付けるようになった。

オマーンは7月、国際海事機関（IMO）に対し、同海峡での通航料徴収には反対すると伝えた。一方で、欧州当局者の一部には、船舶が関連サービスの料金を支払う必要が生じる可能性があると非公式に警告していたと、ブルームバーグが6月に報じた。

items.title: 欧州債に天然ガスの脅威、インフレ懸念の焦点が原油からシフト
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州債トレーダーにとって最大の懸念材料となっているのは、今は原油ではなく天然ガスだ。重要な燃料である天然ガスの在庫減少は、インフレ再燃につながる恐れがある。

欧州の天然ガス価格は5カ月ぶりの高値付近にあり、冬季限月の価格は1年前の2倍を上回っている。ブレント原油が米国とイランの戦争を受けて付けた高値を30％下回る水準で取引される中でも、ドイツと英国の10年債利回りは数十年ぶりの水準に達した。

投資家は、天然ガス価格の上昇でインフレが再燃し、中央銀行が市場の現在の想定以上に積極的な利上げを迫られることを懸念している。天然ガスは域内経済で中心的な役割を担い、欧州連合（EU）のエネルギー構成の21％、英国では25－35％を占める。

CGアセット・マネジメントのポートフォリオマネジャー、エマ・モリアーティ氏は「天然ガス価格は英国と欧州にとってより重要で、いずれの停戦でも実質的に値を戻すことはなく、上昇を続けている」と述べた。

債券利回りの急上昇には、持続不可能な財政状況やハイパースケーラーによる大量の資金調達、予測困難な米国の政策運営といった他の懸念も影響している。ただ市場参加者によると、天然ガス価格は2022年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻後に付けた高値をなお大幅に下回っているものの、欧州と英国の金利見通しにとって現在最大のエネルギー関連リスクとなっている。

中東紛争を受け、各国政府や企業は紛争が短期で終わり、価格が落ち着くことを期待して、貯蔵施設への補充を先送りした。一方、夏の猛暑で需要が増え、天然ガスの貯蔵率は63%にとどまった。この時期としては2009年以来の低水準だ。

原題：Natural Gas Eclipses Oil as Key Inflation Risk for European Debt

items.body:
"Visas are not stopped; they will be rescheduled": Akshar Travels owner Manish Sharma "Those who have taken visa appointments will be rescheduled, and their dates will be changed. They will be provided with full details shortly," Sharma told ANI, adding, "This is a temporary part of the training session, which is why it's currently on hold. Visas are not stopped; they will be rescheduled."
ANI | Updated: 26-08-2026 23:54 IST | Created: 26-08-2026 23:54 IST

Owner of Akash Travels Manish Sharma (Photo/ANI). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Addressing concerns over the sudden worldwide hold on US visa appointments, Akshar Travels owner Manish Sharma clarified that the suspension is entirely temporary and driven by a simultaneous global training session for all consular officers on a new visa processing system. Addressing the impact of the sudden freeze, Sharma explained that those who have already secured visa appointments will have their dates rescheduled.
"Those who have taken visa appointments will be rescheduled, and their dates will be changed. They will be provided with full details shortly," Sharma told ANI, adding, "This is a temporary part of the training session, which is why it's currently on hold. Visas are not stopped; they will be rescheduled." Emphasising the deep-rooted ties between the regions, Sharma noted that travel between India and America forms an integral part of both social and economic systems.
"Gujarat and India are connected with America socially, religiously, and economically. So, the coming and going between the two countries for visas is in some way a part of the economic and social systems of both nations, so it's impossible for it to stop," he said. He further added, "Also, because they are upgrading the visas, it will be very good for the people of the country in the future. Those who are eligible will be able to get visas easily, and their travel to and from America will be easier."
While acknowledging that a simultaneous, worldwide training program for all consulates is unprecedented in his experience, Sharma expects normalisation within a couple of weeks given the heavy commercial and social interdependency between India and the United States. "As far as I know, this is the first time a training session is happening for all consulators simultaneously," Sharma remarked, noting that the training period is unlikely to exceed 10 to 15 days because "billions of dollars worth of business, social systems are also connected."
This comes as the US has paused visa appointments for applicants worldwide as President Donald Trump steps up his immigration crackdown during his second term in the White House, Reuters reported on Tuesday (local time). A US State Department spokesperson stated that the department had launched a global training initiative across all US embassies and consulates worldwide, adding that visa service appointments will be adjusted to accommodate the training, according to the report.
Meanwhile, applicants with interviews already scheduled were emailed that their appointments had been cancelled and that they would be informed of a new date and time, The Financial Times reported. The State Department has not provided a timeline for when the interviews will resume or when fresh appointment dates will be issued, FT reported.
The latest move comes as Trump's second administration intensifies its immigration enforcement agenda, which has included tougher scrutiny of visa and green-card applicants, an aggressive deportation campaign, and an overhaul of refugee admissions. (ANI)

items.summary: A loss at trial could expose Meta to penalties of as much as $1.4 trillion, while a settlement would likely be far smaller
items.body:
Meta, states discuss mid-trial settlement in teen addiction case

a Meta logo on top of a glassy building · Quartz · Photo by Laurent Hou/Hans Lucas /AFP via Getty Images
Cris Tolomia
Wed, August 26, 2026 at 7:19 AM EDT 2 min read

META
+1.07%

Learn more

Meta Platforms and state attorneys general have held talks about a potential settlement before the trial concludes, in a lawsuit that accuses the company of intentionally building Facebook and Instagram in ways meant to hook teenagers, according to Bloomberg .
Entering its second week in federal court in Oakland, California, the trial pits the attorneys general of 29 states against the company, with those officials seeking both monetary penalties and court-ordered changes to how Meta runs its platforms. People familiar with the settlement discussions asked not to be identified due to their sensitivity, according to Bloomberg.

A spokesperson for Meta had no immediate comment. A representative of the California attorney general's office declined to comment, and representatives of the other three states leading the case — Colorado, Kentucky, and New Jersey — did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Meta's internal estimates place the maximum penalty exposure from an adverse verdict at roughly $1.4 trillion, a figure approaching the company's total market capitalization. A settlement would likely amount to a far smaller sum.
At the heart of the states' case are claimed breaches of both state consumer protection statutes and the federal Children's Online Privacy Protection Act, laws whose per-violation fines can compound into enormous totals given the scale of Meta's underage user base. The four lead states — California, Colorado, Kentucky, and New Jersey — are also pressing additional consumer protection claims under their individual state laws, while all 29 states are pursuing federal claims tied to alleged data collection of minors without parental consent.

Meta rejects the states' claims and has characterized the attorneys general's demands as calling for unworkable design changes and an "outlandish payout."
In the trial's opening week, testimony came from Instagram chief Adam Mosseri alongside various current and former Meta employees whose work involved designing the platforms and examining how teenagers engage with features intended to curb excessive use. Attorneys on the case have indicated that Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg is also expected to take the stand.
The trial is one of more than 3,000 federal lawsuits against Meta and other social media companies consolidated before U.S. District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers. California Deputy Attorney General Megan O'Neill described Meta's business model to the eight-person jury as one designed to "hook the users, hold them for as long as they can, harvest their data, and then hide the truth from the public." Meta denied the allegations, saying it had made significant efforts to protect minors online.
The case is People of the State of California v. Meta Platforms Inc., 23-cv-05448, U.S. District Court, Northern District of California (Oakland).

items.title: Chinese Workers Killed in Fire at Russia Gas Complex Co-Owned by Sinopec
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Six Chinese nationals were killed and nine more are missing after a fire broke out at a gas chemical complex in Russia’s far eastern Amur region, the plant said on Wednesday. A total of seven people died, and 152 people were treated for injuries, including …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
Six Chinese nationals were killed and nine more are missing after a fire broke out at a gas chemical complex in Russia’s far eastern Amur region, the plant said on Wednesday.

A total of seven people died, and 152 people were treated for injuries, including 36 who were rushed to hospitals, the plant said on the Telegram messaging app on Wednesday.

The fire, which broke out on Tuesday, was extinguished, it added.

An emergency services plane had arrived to transport the injured to other hospitals in Russia.

The complex, which bills itself as one of the world’s largest polyethylene and polypropylene producers, is a joint project of Russian company Sibur and Chinese oil and gas company Sinopec. It has yet to begin operations and was preparing for production to start.

Russia frequently relies on foreign labor, including workers from China, for the construction of large industrial and infrastructure projects.

Russia’s Investigative Committee said it was investigating the incident as a potential breach of industrial safety regulations and was working to establish the cause of the fire.

The Amur Gas Chemical Complex is expected to produce 2.3 million metric tons of polyethylene and 400,000 tons of polypropylene per year.

items.title: Rupert Grint to return as Ron Weasley for 'Harry Potter and the Cursed Child' Broadway play
items.summary: Dominic McLaughlin stars as Harry Potter, with Alastair Stout as Ron Weasley and Arabella Stanton as Hermione Granger. Other cast members include Nick Frost as Rubeus Hagrid, John Lithgow as Albus ...
items.body:
Rupert Grint to return as Ron Weasley for 'Harry Potter and the Cursed Child' Broadway play Grint will be seen as the adult Ron in the play, which follows the next generation of Hogwarts students.
ANI | Updated: 26-08-2026 23:11 IST | Created: 26-08-2026 23:11 IST

Actor Rupert Grint (File photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Actor Rupert Grint is all set to return as the beloved Ronald Weasley after 15 years. The actor, who famously featured in all eight 'Harry Potter' films from 2001 to 2011, will join the cast of 'Harry Potter and the Cursed Child' at Broadway's Lyric Theatre from February 2 to May 30, 2027. Grint will be seen as the adult Ron in the play, which follows the next generation of Hogwarts students.
"Ron Weasley has been a part of me since I was 11 years old and I can't wait to meet him again in this stage of life. There is something so full-circle and so special about stepping back into Ron's shoes now when we are both fathers; it is somehow both very familiar and completely new. And the joy of being back on Broadway, this time in a role that defined so much of my life, is truly exciting," he said in a statement, as quoted by Variety. Notably, Rupert Grint is not the first original Harry Potter star to have entered the play. Earlier, Tom Felton also joined in as an elder Draco Malfoy.
Speaking on the return of Rupert Grint in his famed role, producers Sonia Friedman and Colin Callender described it as a "powerful bridge between the story audiences and the story of family, legacy, and the passage of time." "Rupert is not simply revisiting a role from his past. He is continuing a journey he began as a child and carrying it forward with all the life and experience he has gained since filming concluded, including a career that has taken him from film to television to acclaimed stage work on both Broadway and the West End. His return creates a powerful bridge between the story audiences first fell in love with and the story of family, legacy and the passage of time that 'Harry Potter and the Cursed Child' carries forward," they said, as per Variety.
This comes at a time when the much-awaited 'Harry Potter' TV series has been in development. The series will air on HBO and stream exclusively on HBO Max.
Dominic McLaughlin stars as Harry Potter, with Alastair Stout as Ron Weasley and Arabella Stanton as Hermione Granger. Other cast members include Nick Frost as Rubeus Hagrid, John Lithgow as Albus Dumbledore, Paapa Essiedu as Severus Snape and Janet McTeer as Professor McGonagall. (ANI)

items.title: タイ中銀、政策金利1％に据え置き継続－危機時には利下げ余地
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： タイ銀行（中央銀行）は26日、政策金利を3会合連続で据え置くとともに、金融政策は引き続き緩和的スタンスを維持すると表明した。一方、危機が発生した場合には利下げの用意があると示唆した。

7人で構成される金融政策委員会は1日物レポ金利を2022年9月以来の低水準である1％に据え置くことを全会一致で決めた。ブルームバーグ・ニュースが調査したエコノミスト23人全員が予想していた通りだった。

中銀は、AIブームの恩恵を受けた輸出と投資により経済が回復基調にあるとし、政府による最近の景気刺激策も回復を支えていると指摘した。

物価上昇圧力は比較的穏やかであるため、金利の据え置きを継続できるが、エルニーニョ現象による干ばつの影響で、2027年1－3月（第1四半期）にかけて総合インフレ率は上昇する可能性がある。ただし、中銀によれば、その後、インフレ率は再び低水準に戻る見込み。

ドン総裁補佐は声明で、「全体的な成長は依然として低く、不均衡な状態にある」としながらも、「委員会は現在の政策金利が経済回復を支える上で適切であると考えている」とコメントした。

総裁補佐はバンコクで行われた政策決定後の記者会見で、インフレ加速を見込んでいるものの、状況を「注視」していると説明。

利下げは実体経済に効果的に波及する上での制約があるため、現時点で正当化されないとしながらも、「利下げの余地がないわけではない。われわれは依然として政策手段を保有しており、危機が発生すれば利下げも可能だが、今は現在の政策スタンスが適切だ」と述べた。

ジブラジ氏は、バリアズニーが世界各地で相次いで進めている幹部採用の最新例となる。同社は過去2年間で、香港とシンガポール、東京の従業員数を40%　増やして約250人とし、昨年のアジア地域の収入は過去最高に達した。グローバルCOOのケビン・バーン氏が1月のインタビューで明らかにしていた。

items.title: ドル160円台へ、日銀「ハト派的」9月利上げなら－ウェルズ・ファーゴ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 日本銀行が今後利上げを継続するというメッセージを発信できなければ、円は来月、1ドル＝160円台に値下がりする可能性があると、米銀ウェルズ・ファーゴはみている。

同行は、日銀が9月の金融政策決定会合で利上げし、その後2027年1月と6月にも利上げを実施し、同年6月末までに政策金利を1.75%に引き上げると、スワップ市場の織り込みとほぼ一致した見方をしている。

「リスクは日銀がタカ派方向ではなく、ハト派方向のサプライズをもたらすことだ」とアジア太平洋担当チーフストラテジストのチドゥ・ナラヤナン氏はリポートで指摘。

「日銀が期待外れとなれば、9月のハト派的な利上げでドル・円は160円を上回り、さらに上昇するリスクがある」とし、「9月に据え置きなら、ドルの上昇余地は一段と大きくなる」と予想した。

日銀が市場の想定通りに利上げしたとしても、財政懸念を背景とした日本国債のイールドカーブ（利回り曲線）スティープ化が円相場の重しになるとみられるため、円高は限定的となる可能性が高い。

ナラヤナン氏は「対ドルでの大幅な円高」には、「日銀によるタカ派方向のサプライズ、財政規律、ドル安」という3つの主要な要因が必要だとし、「このうち2つだけでは不十分だ」と分析。

財政リスク主導の「ベア」スティープ化よりも、近い将来の利上げ期待が主導する「ベア」フラット化の方が円相場を支えやすいと説明し、「日銀がタカ派的な政策対応をしても、財政拡張が続けば、円高は持続しない公算が大きい」と論じた。

items.title: Lynas expands global footprint, eyes new rare earths supply deals
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Australia's Lynas Rare Earths said it planned to grow its global supply chain on Wednesday, with discussions to secure new mine supply from project developers around the world and support a magnet processing supply chain in the United States.
items.body:
(This Aug 26 story has been corrected to clarify that Lynas is supporting the development of a US magnet making supply chain, not setting up a facility, in paragraphs 1 and 5.)
Australia's Lynas Rare Earths said it planned to grow its global supply chain on Wednesday, with discussions to secure new mine supply from project developers around the world and support a magnet processing supply chain in the United States.
The comments came after the world's biggest producer of rare earths outside China reported a sharp rise in annual profit, helped by record average selling prices for rare-earth oxide and strong demand, but missed market expectations. Its shares fell as much as 8%.
Interim CEO Pol Le Roux said Lynas is in talks with project developers of ionic clay deposits around the world for new supply and expects to announce new deals soon. He did not say whether that would involve buying material or acquiring ionic clay businesses.
"I think they held the door ajar and they're considering all of that," said Barrenjoey analyst Daniel Morgan.
Le Roux also said Lynas was in early-stage talks to support the development of a magnet-making supply chain in the U.S.
"But we are on track on that development and more development is to come," he said on an earnings call.
The U.S., Europe and their allies are racing to build supply chains to reduce their dependence on China, which accounts for some 90% of global production of rare earth products, including magnets used in the aerospace, automotive and defence industries.
A one-year suspension on export controls announced by China on several medium and heavy rare earth products expires in November.
SOARING PROFIT MISSES FORECASTS Lynas posted a net profit after tax of A$222.4 million ($159.37 million) for the year ended June 30, up from A$8 million a year ago. That missed a Visible Alpha consensus estimate of A$242.5 million.
It flagged operational challenges tied to ore quality at its Mt Weld mine in Australia, as well as rising costs. However it said it has resolved quality issues at its Kalgoorlie plant.
"They have fixed a whole bunch of problems. It's nice to know they have found better operational stability," Morgan added.
The earnings surge was driven by firm prices and floor price agreements with both Japanese and U.S. customers, which helped reduce volatility, Lynas said.
Its average selling price rose 59% to A$80.7 per kilogram, helped by improved pricing of neodymium-praseodymium, a key rare‑earth magnet material, and a higher share of heavy rare-earth sales and sales with pricing not linked to the market index.
Customers continued to prioritise sustainable rare-earth supply chains outside China amid export restrictions, while strong demand lifted sales volumes, it said.
The company is searching for a new CEO, following the retirement of [USN:L4N3YD1VT TEXT:"Amanda Lacaze"].
($1 = 1.3955 Australian dollars)

items.title: BNP Paribas, KB Kookmin in talks for $2 billion Vietnam Techcombank stake, sources say
items.author: Yantoultra Ngui, Phuong Nguyen
items.creator: Yantoultra Ngui, Phuong Nguyen
items.summary: France's BNP Paribas and South Korea's KB Kookmin Bank are in separate talks to acquire at least a 15% stake in Vietnam's Techcombank as strategic investors, two sources said, athough BNP subsequently said it has no plans to acquire an equity stake in the lender.
items.body:
France's BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) and South Korea's KB Kookmin Bank are in separate talks to acquire at least a 15% stake in Vietnam's Techcombank (TCB.HM) as strategic investors, two sources said, athough BNP subsequently said it has no plans to acquire an equity stake in the lender.
The potential deal, which has not been reported previously, would give the winner rare access to Vietnam's [USN:L4N3Y60GT TEXT:"fast-growing"] banking market and end Techcombank's long search for a foreign strategic partner.
Techcombank is seeking a valuation of about two times its book value, said the sources, who are familiar with the deal discussions but spoke on condition of anonymity as they were not authorised to speak to the media.
If agreed, that would value a 15% stake in Vietnam's third-largest privately owned bank by total assets at around $2 billion, and would represent about a 55% premium over its last closing price.
Techcombank shares rose as much as 7% in afternoon trading on Wednesday after the Reuters report.
KB Kookmin Bank said it would not comment on market rumours or speculation, as part of South Korea's capital markets and disclosure rules.
BNP Paribas, which declined to comment on the deal on Wednesday, said in a statement on Thursday that it has no plans to acquire an equity stake in Techcombank.
Spokesperson for Techcombank declined to comment.
The latest deal talks come as [USN:L6N44A09N TEXT:"foreign banks"] are seeking a bigger foothold in Vietnam by extending hard-currency loans to local lenders squeezed between rising domestic funding costs and government pressure to expand credit.
Several foreign banks operate in Vietnam through branches, and more could enter under the government's plan to establish international financial centres, analysts said, though key details remain unclear.
Japanese and South Korean banks are already strategic investors in some of the country's largest lenders. Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp (8316.T) bought a [USN:L4N35Z0SQ TEXT:"15% stake"] in VPBank (VPB.HM) in 2023.
FAST-GROWING BANKING SECTOR Vietnam caps foreign ownership at 30% for most banks. In Techcombank, foreign ownership currently stands at around 20.5%, and the sources said interested bidders are weighing several options including purchases from existing foreign investors.
No formal agreement has been reached and there is no certainty that the talks would result in a deal, they said, adding Techcombank was likely to select only one of the two bidders.
Valuation remains the main hurdle as Techcombank is seeking a sharply higher premium to its current market value, one of the sources said, adding that a strategic buyer would be buying future growth and access to a scarce banking platform.
A deal could be reached by the end of 2026 or the first half of 2027, depending on negotiations, the sources said.
Techcombank has long said it is open to a foreign strategic investor. It is one of Vietnam's few large privately owned banks without such a strategic partner.
For BNP Paribas or KB Kookmin, a Techcombank stake would offer exposure to Vietnam's expanding middle class, rising wealth management demand and fast-growing private banking sector.
BNP Paribas and KB Kookmin Bank already operate branches in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, while KB Financial Group (105560.KS) , Kookmin's parent, has a majority-owned securities unit in Vietnam.
Founded in 1993, Techcombank had more than 18 million clients at the end of 2025 and covered well over half of Vietnam's high-net-worth and affluent customers, according to its 2025 annual report.
Techcombank's total assets were 1,273 trillion dong ($48.76 billion) at the end of June 2026, with customer deposits amounting to 697.4 trillion dong, according to its financial statements.
First-half pretax profit [USN:L6N43P08D TEXT:"rose"] 22.5% from a year earlier to 18.5 trillion dong, driven by growth in net interest income and fee income, according to the bank.
($1 = 26,107.0000 dong)

items.title: Tungsten West scores $97M UK investment, stock soars
items.author: Marina Meireles
items.creator: Marina Meireles
items.summary: The company announced it will restart tungsten and tin production at the historic Hemerdon mine by this year’s third quarter.
items.body:
Tungsten West scores $97M UK investment, stock soars

Marina Meireles | August 25, 2026 | 11:36 am
Critical Minerals   Markets   Europe   Tin   Tungsten  

( Image: Tungsten West. )

Tungsten West (AIM:TUN) announced Tuesday that the UK Government will invest up to $97 million (£71 million) to restart production at the historic Hemerdon tungsten and tin mine in Devon. The stock soared.

The equity and debt investment comes from the National Wealth Fund (NWF) and aims to get the mine back to full production and develop a secure domestic tungsten source, a critical mineral essential to high-technology supply chains, aerospace, energy and defence.

The mine supplied crucial tungsten for military and defense efforts during both World War I and World War II. Mining continued on and off through the mid-20th century before shutting down in 1944.

“This investment will supply vital minerals to British defence, energy and aerospace businesses and keep good, well-paid jobs in the UK. All part of this Government’s commitment to drive growth in every postcode, back British business and keep our country safe,” John Healey, Chancellor of the Exchequer, said in a news release.

Tungsten West and NWF now have a shareholder relationship agreement, which gives the NWF the chance to nominate one non-executive director to the board of the company. The investment makes it possible for Tungsten West to resume full production at Hemerdon, producing tungsten and creating 350 direct jobs.

Production to resume soon

Tungsten and tin concentrate have already been produced in Hemerdon in this past month, the company said, as they conduct final tests to start production still in 2026. The company also said it is negotiating with a major down-stream tungsten refiner.

“Hemerdon is a world class, low cost and long-life tungsten and tin resource in the UK. Through the support of the UK Government, we are ensuring that critical minerals produced at Hemerdon will underpin the UK’s national interests for the long term,” Jeff Court, CEO of Tungsten West, said. 

Bloomberg News reported that Hemerdon had faced difficulties to restart the mine due to cost overruns, volatile prices and funding constraints previously.

Tungsten West’s shares were up about 17% at 50.25 pence a share by 12:24 p.m. in London, valuing the firm at about £627 million ($855 million).

(With files from Bloomberg)

items.title: Gold price rises, silver slips on Treasury cash-pile buyback signal
items.author: Scott Spence
items.creator: Scott Spence
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent could tap a $935 billion cash pile to fund bond buybacks.
items.body:
Gold price rises, silver slips on Treasury cash-pile buyback signal

Scott Spence | August 24, 2026 | 10:50 am
Markets   USA   Gold   Silver  

Stock image.

Gold rose while silver slipped on Monday after CNBC reported that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent could tap a $935 billion cash pile to fund bond buybacks, pushing long-term yields lower.

The department could draw on the Treasury General Account to fund buybacks of higher-yielding older securities, CNBC reported Monday, citing two senior Treasury officials.

The TGA, essentially the government’s checking account at the Federal Reserve, stood at $935 billion as of Aug. 20. Bessent called the operation a “Treasury Twist” in a CNBC interview, a reference to buying long-term bonds funded by short-term issuance.

The officials would not say how much, if any, of the TGA would be used. The report follows Bessent’s decision last week to double buybacks on the long end from $2 billion to at least $4 billion. Gold climbed 1.2% as of 12.30pm in New York, near a four-month high around $4,719 an ounce.

The 10-year Treasury yield fell as much as four basis points to 4.69%, and the all-important 30- year dropped to around 5.215%. Yields are slightly lower, however they remain near the levels that prompted the Treasury to intervene last week, when the 30-year touched a 19-year high above 5.27%.

Silver is down around 1% on the day, as price consolidates below the $70 resistance level. Silver has outrun gold in August, up almost 20% on the month vs gold’s 15%.

Copper gained a modest 0.46% and trades just below its all-time highs.

Another Band-aid

Monday’s Treasury move drew skepticism from Blake Gwinn, head of US rate strategy at RBC< Capital Markets, who called it “a very slapdash attempt to try to stem the selloff” and put the odds of the department actually using the cash at “very, very low,” Bloomberg reported.

The Treasury expanded its buyback program last week after long-dated yields hit multi-year highs, a move that provided only temporary relief as the 30-year yield erased the gains within a day. The week ahead will test investors, the Fed and the Treasury.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole speech Friday, and July PCE data lands Wednesday, with economists surveyed by Bloomberg forecasting about 3.6% headline and 3.3% core year-over-year.

The Treasury will have it’s eyes firmly glued to long term rates.

(With files from Bloomberg)

items.title: India, China Walk a Delicate Borderline in Preparation for BRICS Summit
items.author: Arthur Kaufman
items.creator: Arthur Kaufman
items.summary: India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is visiting Beijing on Monday and Tuesday  this week and will meet Wang Yi as part of the 25th round of talks between each country’s Special Representatives on the border issue. The visit comes a few weeks before a …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is visiting Beijing on Monday and Tuesday  this week and will meet Wang Yi as part of the 25th round of talks between each country’s Special Representatives on the border issue.

The visit comes a few weeks before a BRICS summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13 that Xi Jinping is expected to attend. It would mark Xi’s first visit to India in seven years and potentially confirm the thaw in relations between India and China.

However, recent news related to their border has complicated  efforts to improve the bilateral relationship .

On August 7,  New Delhi published a controversial new map  that renamed 27 locations in Arunachal Pradesh, referred to as Zangnan or South Tibet by the Chinese, along the Line of Actual Control. This occurred just one day after a meeting between officials from both sides under the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination on border affairs.

The South China Morning Post also published an article on Sunday highlighting  China’s plans to build a vast, 25,000-kilometer “national ring road” along its borders , including the southwestern G219 highway whose upgrades and extensions are taking place in areas disputed by New Delhi.

Despite pushing for warmer relations, India is also seeking to increase its economic independence from China in certain areas. Reuters reported last Friday that, according to government sources,  India is set to approve a $1.2 billion incentive scheme  for producing high-value construction and infrastructure equipment to reduce dependence on China for critical machinery. 

In other news, a cargo ship carrying 24 crew members, 20 of whom are Chinese nationals,  sank off of India’s eastern coast on Sunday . India’s coastguard has so far rescued two Chinese nationals as search-and-rescue operations continue.

WHY IS THIS IMPORTANT?  The Indian and Chinese governments are trying to maintain a delicate diplomatic balancing act. Their move toward better diplomatic ties and a successful BRICS summit with Xi’s attendance requires toning down longstanding disagreements over border issues, while not appearing to capitulate to the other side in the eyes of their respective domestic constituents.

items.title: Gold price gets US bond policy boost
items.author: Northern Miner Staff
items.creator: Northern Miner Staff
items.summary: Gold hit a three-month high as the US Treasury expanded bond purchases, weakening the dollar amid rising debt concerns.
items.body:
Gold price gets US bond policy boost

Colin McClelland | August 21, 2026 | 8:01 am
Markets   USA   Gold  

The World Gold Council identifies how bullion benefits from economic policy. Credit: Adobe Stock Photo by monsitj.

Gold’s surge to about $4,600 per oz. this week may have further to run if US policymakers increasingly intervene to hold down long-term borrowing costs, according to the World Gold Council.

Bullion climbed to a three-month high Friday after the United States Treasury unexpectedly expanded purchases of longer-dated government bonds, weakening the US dollar and reinforcing investor concerns over Washington’s growing debt burden — which hit $40 trillion just this week after doubling in less than a decade.

The Treasury announced Aug. 19 that it would double buybacks of longer-dated Treasuries after yields climbed to their highest levels in years. The move immediately pushed bond yields and the dollar lower while sending spot gold up more than 3% to nearly $4,500 per oz., its biggest one-day gain since February. By Friday, bullion had climbed above $4,600, extending its rally to a third straight week.

Cambridge University economist Mohamed El-Erian said the Treasury’s action was “not yield-curve control (YCC) but it might be a step in that direction,” a view highlighted by the World Gold Council in a report on Friday examining what the policy shift could mean for bullion investors.

The council argues that the Treasury’s announcement reflects a deeper challenge confronting US financial markets. Persistent fiscal deficits require ever-larger bond issuance while a rapidly expanding stock of outstanding debt must also be refinanced. At the same time, some of the market’s traditional buyers are becoming less dependable. Foreign central banks are diversifying reserves, and investors abroad have alternatives offering attractive returns.

Hedge funds

Banks remain constrained by capital rules and corporate borrowing tied to artificial intelligence and data-centre construction is competing for investor capital, said Johan Palmberg, senior quantitative analyst at the World Gold Council . A growing share of Treasury demand now comes from more price-sensitive investors such as hedge funds.

Those pressures have left investors demanding higher compensation for holding long-dated government debt, Palmberg said. The recent rise in Treasury yields suggests markets no longer assume Washington’s expanding debt supply will be absorbed effortlessly, he said. Instead, the balance between supply and demand is becoming an increasingly important driver of bond prices.

If market pressures continue, policymakers could eventually consider yield-curve control, under which the US Federal Reserve would buy bonds to cap longer-term interest rates directly, he said. While the Treasury’s approach is being presented as a market-functioning measure, Palmberg suggested the distinction could become blurred.

“Just because it walks like a duck and quacks like a duck, doesn’t mean it’s a duck,” he wrote. “It’s monetary policy’s version of plausible deniability.”

Intraday reaction to Treasury buyback announcement on 19 August 2026.
Source: Bloomberg, World Gold Council

The policy was used in the United States during the 1940s and has also been adopted in recent years by Japan and Australia. Unlike quantitative easing, which targets the quantity of bonds purchased and substantially expands a central bank’s balance sheet, yield-curve control targets a specific interest rate and can require much less intervention if markets believe policymakers will defend the ceiling.

How gold benefits

For gold investors, Palmberg sees three principal benefits if the United States eventually moves in that direction. First, yield-curve control would probably weaken the US dollar by shifting the adjustment away from bond markets and into the currency.

“The expensive US dollar is already facing pressure from several corners and YCC . . . could increasingly force the adjustment through the currency rather than the bond market,” he wrote.

Because gold is priced in US dollars, a weaker greenback generally makes bullion cheaper for buyers using other currencies and tends to support prices.

Second, capping government bond yields while inflation remains elevated would likely reduce real interest rates. Gold has historically performed well when inflation-adjusted bond yields decline because the opportunity cost of holding a non-yielding asset falls.

Third, investors could increasingly view gold as protection against what economists call financial repression — governments holding borrowing costs below market levels to make debt more manageable.

AI issuance sourced from Dallas Fed  How AI debt financing impacts duration supply and interest rates – Dallasfed.org . Treasury issuance sourced from SIFMA
Source: Bloomberg, Dallas Fed, SIFMA, World Gold Council

Uncertainty

“A Treasury market that clears at an administratively influenced price brings uncertainty because investors don’t know where yields would settle absent intervention,” Palmberg wrote. He added that “markets can be relentless. It doesn’t require aggressive short sellers . . . just an absence of buyers.”

Palmberg cautioned that the outcome would not necessarily be uniformly positive for bullion. A credible and temporary yield-curve control program could restore confidence in bond markets, compress risk premiums and reduce safe-haven demand for gold despite lower yields.

History also suggests such policies can be difficult to maintain. The US experience in the 1940s eventually collided with rising inflation and questions over Federal Reserve independence. Even so, Palmberg believes the broader investment case for gold remains intact.

“The debt mountain concern . . . remains one of the pillars of gold demand and any attempts to manage that burden not involving a reduction of debt or deficits are likely to continue favouring gold.”

items.title: Norway's King Harald in 'very serious' health condition, royal court says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The health of Norway's King Harald, 89, has deteriorated while in hospital and his condition is now "very serious", the royal court said on Thursday.
items.body:
The health of Norway's King Harald, 89, has deteriorated while in hospital and his condition is now "very serious", the royal court said on Thursday.
Europe's oldest living monarch and Norway's ceremonial head of state since 1991, Harald was taken to hospital on August 17. The palace said he was being treated for a bacterial infection in his blood.
Crown Prince Haakon and Harald's wife, Queen Sonja, have both cancelled all planned events, the palace said in a statement.
Members of Harald's family, including the crown prince and the queen, were seen arriving at the Oslo University Hospital where the king is being treated, Norwegian media reported.
Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Stoere on Thursday cancelled a trip to Germany due to the king's condition and said in a statement to the media, "The whole nation is with us as we send warm thoughts to the king and the rest of the royal family."
The speaker of Norway's parliament, Masud Gharahkhani, broke off an official visit to Iceland and was heading back to Norway, while the Committee of Foreign Relations and Defence said its members would return home from South Korea.
The Lutheran Church of Norway's College of Bishops, in Rome for a rare visit with the pope, announced it would return home as soon as possible, according to media reports.
In 2024, the king said he would reduce the number of official activities in which he takes part out of consideration for his age, but he ruled out abdication, saying his oath as king was for life.
items.raw_description: The health of Norway's King Harald, 89, has deteriorated while in hospital and his condition is now "very serious", the royal court said on Thursday.
